name: The Paper Aeroplane
summary: A paper aeroplane, already folded. One for £4, or a pack of five for £15.
concept: One paper aeroplane, folded in advance, in 100 gsm paper. One model.
why_it_exists: Folding one takes a minute and a clear desk. This one is already folded.
target_customer: Anyone with a desk, a stairwell or a long corridor.

physical.form: A folded paper aeroplane in one design.
physical.dimensions: 260 mm long, 150 mm wingspan. Envelope about 270 x 160 mm.

features: It is already folded, so it is ready to fly the moment you open the envelope.
The paper is a firm 100 gsm, which holds its shape in the air.
It is one design that flies in a straight line.
You can buy one, or a pack of five if you want a race.
It comes with simple tips for fixing a dive or a stall.
arrives: It is posted flat in a brown card envelope, so the wings stay crisp. The envelope is plain and recyclable. Open it gently, and it is ready to throw.
specs: 100 gsm uncoated paper. Kraft card envelope.
White paper with one pink wing edge
Single, or pack of five (five identical aeroplanes)
Keep it dry and flat. Flatten the wings gently if they bend.
how_it_works: Hold it under the body and throw it level. If it dives, bend the back edge of the wings up a little. If it climbs and stalls, bend it down.
in_the_box: One folded aeroplane, or five, in a kraft envelope

compatibility.note: Pre-popped Bubble Wrap is a fine soft wrap for posting one.
Not a pair. Stones do not fly like aeroplanes.

packaging: A kraft card envelope. Plain, flat and recyclable.

warranty.summary: It has no warranty, because it is paper.

care: If the wings bend, flatten them gently.
Recycle it when it has been through enough.
safety: Do not throw it at faces. The corners can hurt eyes.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days if it is unused and in its box. See Returns.

sections.title: One design
sections.body: It is 260 mm long, in 100 gsm paper, and folded before it arrives.

sections.title: One or five
sections.body: One is £4. A pack of five is £15.

sections.title: Throwing it
sections.body: Hold it under the body and throw it level. It is paper, so it lasts as long as paper does.

faq.a: It depends on your throw and the room. We do not promise a distance.
Yes. Folding it again takes a few minutes.
Yes, within 30 days, if it is unused and in its envelope.

steps: Bend the back edge of both wings up a little.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Flatten the wings and try again.

steps: Bend the back edge of the wings down a little.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Check both wings are the same shape.

photography_direction: One folded aeroplane in off-white with a pink wing edge on a pale backdrop. No people.
